in_hebrew.name: Ilinka
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ilinka הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Helios, the god of the sun, had a daughter named Ilinka. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'helios,' meaning sun. Ilinka represents the radiance and warmth of the sun, symbolizing hope, illumination, and life.
